rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
compound object of knowing; concealed essential being
state of omniscience that comes into being
main verb indicating the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What realization brings about the arising of omniscience in the knower?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
That hidden true nature can be directly known.
Direct knowledge of this nature produces a transformative result.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature results in the arising of omniscience.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the immediately preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
